_about: INVUI (spec 13) presentation data: sort keys, filter groups (icon = a white ui_icons id, grid = the procedural four-square glyph; the storage view's left rail), attribute classes, equipment layout, presets, power groups. Read by InvView, InvAttributes, EquipmentSlot, GearPresets and InvStats. Every value marked ASSUMPTION in docs/orchestration/mmo/invui-spec.md section 9.

attribute_classes._about: Spec 04 lines 8-11. Key = ItemStack.attributes key; value in the stack is the trait level (int) or true. Keys not listed here (tint, level, material_tier, hardness, food_buff, toxin_hits, barbed_hits, species, genetics, grade, grade_seed, variant, climate, anchor, feathered, processed) are technical and never shown.

equipment_grid._about: 3x3 like the Character -> Gear reference: row 1 accessory/head/accessory, row 2 main hand/torso/held tool, row 3 gloves/legs/empty. Empty string = no cell content.

powers._about: Character panel power rows = the highest skill level in each group (SkillState trees, 1-60). Chevron opens Detailed Stats at that group.

detailed_stats._about: Detailed Stats groups (spec 13 s13: only statistics the game has). stats = InvStats.snapshot keys; power = a powers group whose trees list as skill levels; trees = extra skill trees.

hex_tactics._about: My Info's hexagon row: the survivor's combat tactics (combat_tuning.json sections; roll is player_sim's dodge). Tap shows the line.

lines.tackle: Tackle: lunge into the target; it goes groggy.
lines.roll: Roll: dodge out of a bite.

category_labels._about: Family chips on the inspect panel read ItemDef.categories; ids that do not read well capitalised get a label here.

storage._about: Storage / cargo view (spec 13 s17 + the 2026-10-20 storage-transfer reference): compartment width the column count aims for, desktop and phone (NEW beside Lv. NN fits).

flavour._about: The item card's plain description line (the in-game Bag reference shows one under Info). Says what the thing is, never a mechanic or lore; an item without a line shows none. ASSUMPTION 74.
flavour.raw_meat: A cut of fresh meat from a hunted animal.
flavour.herb_leaf: A leaf from a wild herb.
flavour.raptor_hide: The feathered hide of a raptor.
flavour.flint: A nodule of flint with glassy, sharp edges.
flavour.branch: A straight branch broken from a tree.
flavour.wood_log: A length of log from a felled tree.
flavour.ore: Rough rock with metal in it.
flavour.stone_knife: A stone blade bound to a handle.
